- key_parameters: <method=In sc_distanceObj(), specifies the distance metric ("euclidean", "cosine", "pearson", "spearman", "L1", "MI") ;; method=In sc_DimensionalityReductionObj(), specifies the dimensionality reduction technique ("PCA", "ICA", "tSNE", "classical-MDS", "nonmetric-MDS") ;; dim=In sc_DimensionalityReductionObj(), specifies the number of dimensions to retain ;; clust.method=In sc_clusterObj(), specifies the clustering algorithm ("max.distance", "percent", "knn", "k-medoids", "complete") ;; graph.algorithm=In sc_GraphBuilderObj(), specifies the graph-building algorithm ("MST", "SST", "IMC") ;; graph.using.cells.clustering=In sc_GraphBuilderObj(), logical indicating whether to use previous clustering results ;; num_it=In statistical support functions, specifies the number of iterations (e.g., 100 for speed, 1000 recommended) ;; method=In sc_InSilicoCellsReplicatesObj(), specifies the noise model for generating replicates ("variance.deciles", "cv2.deciles", "lognormal-3parameters", "negative.binomial")>
- alternatives: <monocle=Mentioned for differential gene testing and filtering of the expression matrix prior to Sincell analysis ;; DESeq2=Mentioned for variance stabilizing transformations (e.g., rlog) to address mean-variance relationships ;; biomaRt=Used to map Ensembl gene identifiers to HGCN symbols ;; rgl=Used for 3D visualization of cells in low-dimensional space ;; GRM=Mentioned for technical noise removal using spike-in molecules prior to Sincell analysis>
- when_to_use: <Appropriate when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq data to reconstruct differentiation, activation, or developmental trajectories (cell-state hierarchies) and evaluate their statistical robustness against technical and biological noise.>
- pitfalls: <High dimensionality can lead to long computing times; restrict the analysis to the most variable protein-coding genes (e.g., top 2000) ;; Raw RNA-seq counts have mean-dependent variance, which biases PCA/clustering; perform a variance stabilizing transformation (e.g., log-transformation or rlog) before initializing the Sincell object ;; ICA and t-SNE are stochastic optimization algorithms, meaning different runs can lead to slightly different solutions ;; Avoid creating large clusters in hierarchical or k-medoids clustering as they risk masking meaningful gradients in downstream graphs ;; The negative binomial noise model (method="negative.binomial" in sc_InSilicoCellsReplicatesObj) should only be used with normalized count data, not length-normalized RPKM/FPKM values>

workflows.name: hierarchy_reconstruction_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Build and visualize cell-state hierarchies from a single-cell expression matrix using dimensionality reduction, optional clustering, and graph-building algorithms.
input: ExpressionMatrix (normalized single-cell expression matrix with genes as rows and cells as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Log-transform and filter the expression matrix ;; 2. Initialize the Sincell object ;; 3. Perform dimensionality reduction (e.g., ICA, PCA, t-SNE) ;; 4. (Optional) Cluster cells to group highly similar cells ;; 5. Build the cell-state hierarchy graph (MST, SST, or IMC) ;; 6. Extract the hierarchy graph for visualization
workflows.code:
data(ExpressionMatrix)
EMlog <- unique(
       log(ExpressionMatrix[which(apply(ExpressionMatrix,1,var)>0),]+1)
       )
EMlog <- as.matrix( EMlog[as.logical(apply(!is.nan(EMlog),1,sum)),])
SO<-sc_InitializingSincellObject(EMlog)
SO <- sc_DimensionalityReductionObj(SO, method="ICA", dim=2)
SO <- sc_clusterObj (SO, clust.method="knn", mutual=TRUE, k=5)
SO<- sc_GraphBuilderObj(SO, graph.algorithm="SST", 
	graph.using.cells.clustering=TRUE)
cellstateHierarchy_SST_clustKNN<-SO[["cellstateHierarchy"]]

workflows.name: statistical_support_assessment
workflows.intent: Evaluate the robustness of reconstructed cell-state hierarchies against noise using gene resampling and in silico cell replicates.
input: EMlog_t0 (log-transformed single-cell expression matrix for a specific condition/timepoint)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the Sincell object, perform dimensionality reduction, and build the base hierarchy ;; 2. Assess statistical support via gene resampling ;; 3. Generate in silico cell replicates based on a noise model ;; 4. Assess statistical support via random cell substitution with the generated replicates
workflows.code:
SO_t0 <- sc_InitializingSincellObject(EMlog_t0)
SO_t0 <- sc_DimensionalityReductionObj(SO_t0, method="ICA",dim=2)
SO_t0 <- sc_GraphBuilderObj(SO_t0, graph.algorithm="MST", 
	graph.using.cells.clustering=FALSE)
SO_t0<-sc_StatisticalSupportByGeneSubsampling(SO_t0, num_it=100)
SO_t0 <- sc_InSilicoCellsReplicatesObj(SO_t0, 
	method="variance.deciles", multiplier=100)
SO_t0<-sc_StatisticalSupportByReplacementWithInSilicoCellsReplicates(SO_t0,
	num_it=100,fraction.cells.to.replace=1)

workflows.name: functional_association_testing
workflows.intent: Test the association of a reconstructed cell-state hierarchy with predefined gene sets (e.g., pathways).
input: SO_t72 (Sincell object containing a reconstructed hierarchy)
geneset.list (list of gene sets, e.g., loaded from a GMT file)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the gene sets ;; 2. Run the association test for gene sets that meet the minimum size overlap with the expression matrix
workflows.code:
data(geneset.list)
minimum.geneset.size=30
myAssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet<-list()
for (i in 1:length(geneset.list)){
  if(sum(rownames(SO_t72[["expressionmatrix"]]) 
  	%in% geneset.list[[i]])>=minimum.geneset.size){
	
    SO_t72<-sc_AssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet(SO_t72,geneset.list[[i]],
    	minimum.geneset.size=minimum.geneset.size,p.value.assessment=TRUE,
	spearman.rank.threshold=0.5,num_it=1000)
    myAssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet[[
    	as.character(i)]]<-list()
    myAssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet[[
    	as.character(i)]][["AssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet"]]<-
		SO[["AssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet"]]
    myAssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet[[
    	as.character(i)]][["AssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet.pvalue"]]<-
	SO[["AssociationOfCellsHierarchyWithAGeneSet.pvalue"]]
  }
}
